xs.$description: Icon beside 12px text, such as in Kbd. The same at every density. Follows the UI font size, 4px smaller than the default icon.

sm.$description: Small icon or mark, such as a Badge icon or a menu check. The same at every density. Follows the UI font size, 2px smaller than the default icon.

default.$description: Icon in a control, at every control size. The same at every density. Follows the UI font size in even pixels.
